name: Corner diner (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Small corner diner, 10 x 8 m: white render over a red-tiled stall riser, wrap-round windows with a fabric awning, a blank sign panel on the parapet, a flat roof with an extract fan and a packaged air-conditioning unit. Enterable: the dining room with a counter, fixed stools and two booths, a street door and a side door, and the kitchen behind with a cooking line under a stainless hood ducted through the roof.
